title: Trust Policy
description: Per-repo and per-task-kind authorization. The OpenClaw adapter resolves a task's trust_level against this policy at enqueue time. Workers re-check on claim. Humans review anything that escalates beyond what the policy permits.

default.description: Applies to any repo not explicitly listed in 'repos'.

grants.description: Time-limited explicit trust grants in agent-worker.mjs's model (M5.2a). A task that matches a non-expired grant per `grantMatchesTask` semantics (worker + repo + mode + filesystem + can_run_tests + network=off + no dangerous_bypass + timeout ≤ max) is reported by `worker.sh trust-check` as auto-approvable. `default`/`repos` govern this layer's M4 policy-routing path (whether tasks land in queued vs awaiting-approval at enqueue); `grants[]` governs explicit pre-authorization that an orchestrator can use to lift the awaiting-approval gate. Coexistence is intentional during the M5 bridge.

max_trust_level.description: Ceiling for any task on this repo. A task whose computed trust_level exceeds this is rejected at enqueue.

allow_kinds.description: Task kinds permitted on this repo. Values must be from the worker-task `kind` enum (M5.1 added 'debug').

deny_kinds.description: Task kinds ONLY — values must be from the worker-task `kind` enum. A kind listed here is refused on this repo even if covered by allow_kinds elsewhere. Trust levels do NOT belong here (use max_trust_level or require_human_approval_for for those).

require_human_approval_for.description: Either task kinds (from the worker-task `kind` enum) OR trust levels (from `max_trust_level` enum). Mixing is intentional: e.g. ['code-change', 'elevated'] blocks any code-change task AND any task at the elevated trust level. Any entry listed here always blocks on human approval, regardless of source.

files_denied.description: Glob patterns workers must refuse to touch on this repo (secrets, prod configs, etc).

expires_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiry. After this time, the policy is treated as absent: doctor flags as expired, OpenClaw refuses to enqueue tasks against this repo until the policy is renewed.

Grant.description: Mirrors agent-worker.mjs grant shape so .mjs's existing trust policy migrates verbatim and round-trips cleanly. Mode and filesystem vocabularies are .mjs's (review/debug/implement/research/explain; read_only/workspace_write); trust-check translates task.kind ↔ mode and task.trust_level ↔ filesystem at match time.
